stories:
Once upon a time there was a little olive. He was very patient and kind. Every day he was very helpful to everyone he met.
One day, he met a fierce dragon flying in the sky. The dragon was very angry and wanted to hurt the little olive. When the dragon saw the little olive, he immediately struck the ground with his powerful claws.
The little olive was very scared and ran away. But the dragon was too fast and soon the dragon was right behind him. The dragon struck the olive with all his strength. The olive was instantly gone.
The dragon flew away, leaving the olive gone forever.

Once upon a time, there was a big dragon. The dragon was very hungry. He looked for food everywhere but he couldn't find any. Then he saw a little girl. The little girl was very kind. She gave the dragon some food to eat. The dragon was happy and he said thank you. The little girl asked the dragon if he wanted to play dress up. The dragon said yes and they had fun dressing up together. From that day on, the dragon and the little girl became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight. He had a sword that was very sharp. One day, he went on an adventure to find a treasure. He walked and walked until he found a big cave. 
Inside the cave, there was a dragon! The knight was scared, but he remembered his incredible sword. He took it out and swung it at the dragon. The dragon tried to stop the knight, but he was too strong. 
Finally, the dragon stopped and the knight found the treasure. He was happy and went back to his castle. Everyone was proud of him and he felt incredible. From that day on, he knew that his sword could help him in any adventure. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a birthday party. There were lots of people there and they were all very happy. There was a fierce dragon that everyone wanted to scare away. So they all shouted and jumped around. 
The dragon was not scared. It stepped forward and roared. Everyone was so surprised, they all stopped to watch the fierce dragon.
Then one little brave boy stepped forward. He was very small with big eyes. He started to jump around, even higher and faster than anyone else. 
The dragon became scared and flew away. Everyone cheered and clapped for the little brave boy. He was so happy that he jumped around even more! 
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight called Sam. He was on a mission to rescue an ancient castle from the dragon who had been living in it for years. Sam looked for the dragon and finally found him in the highest tower of the castle. The dragon had an enormous umbrella that he was using as a shield. 
Sam asked the dragon: "Please let me rescue the castle. It is ancient and must be protected!" 
The dragon replied: "I cannot let you do that. This castle is my home and nobody can take it from me!" 
But Sam didn't give up. He used all his courage and strength, charging towards the dragon. Suddenly, the dragon lost his grip on the umbrella and Sam seized it. With the umbrella in his hand, Sam was finally able to rescue the castle and lead everybody out to safety.

Once upon a time, there was a brave man. He had a big sword. He was very patient. He would mark the sword every single day before going on an adventure. 
One day he went on a long journey. He came to a big castle with a big door. He knew he had to be very patient to open the door. He marked the edge of his sword and knocked on the door.
Then something very wonderful happened. The door opened! inside the castle, the brave man found a great big treasure. But it was guarded by a dragon!
The brave man was very patient, and he used his sword to mark the dragon. He kept marking and marking until the dragon fell asleep. The brave man was victorious! He took the treasure and went home. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy dragon living in a large golden cave. He surrounded himself with enormous amounts of shiny coins and precious jewels and had the finest things of all.
One day, the dragon heard someone outside his cave. He peered out and saw a small child. She was crying softly as she lay looking up at the stars.
The dragon felt sorry for her and asked why she was upset. The child replied that she was lost and had no way to get home. The dragon was so kind that he offered to help. 
He said, "Don't worry, I know of a place where you can go. It's a wonderful place and it's not too far from here. You can stay with them and they will help you." 
The dragon took the child by the hand and together they flew through the night sky. As they arrived, the dragon said, "Welcome to your new home! This is where you lay your head." 
The child couldn't believe how lucky she was and thanked the dragon for all his help. From then on, the dragon visited the child often and with his generosity, the child ended up living in a very wealthy home.

Once upon a time, there was an old, old castle. It was so old that people called it an "ancient" castle. Inside the castle, there was a big treasure case. The treasure case was filled with gold and jewels. 
One day, a princess came to visit the castle. She saw the treasure case and she wanted to take it home with her. But the castle was guarded by a big, scary dragon. The princess was scared, but she had an idea. She decided to wave at the dragon and say hello. 
To her surprise, the dragon was friendly! He let her take the treasure case and even helped her carry it to her carriage. The princess was very happy and she waved goodbye to the dragon as she left the ancient castle. From that day on, she knew that sometimes all you have to do is wave and say hello to make a new friend.

One day, a big dragon lived in a cave. The cave was dark and empty. The dragon was sad and lonely. He wanted a friend to play with.
A little boy named Tom walked near the cave. He saw the dragon and said, "Hi, dragon! Can I be your friend?" The dragon was happy and said, "Yes, Tom! Let's play!" They played all day and had fun.
The next day, Tom came back to the cave. He saw a big door. Tom said, "Dragon, let's open the door and see what's inside!" The dragon and Tom opened the door. Inside, they found a big, empty room. They played in the room, but then the door closed. They tried to open the door, but it was stuck. Tom and the dragon were trapped in the empty room. They were sad and scared.

Anna and Ben liked to play in the park. They liked to run, slide, swing and climb. One day, they saw a big cloud of mist near the pond. They wanted to see what was inside.
"Let's go, Anna!" Ben said. "Maybe there are fairies or dragons in the mist!"
"No, Ben, we can't!" Anna said. "Mommy told us to stay away from the pond. She said it is deep and cold and dangerous. We have to be obedient."
But Ben did not listen. He ran to the mist and jumped in. Anna followed him. She did not want to lose her brother.
They felt wet and cold in the mist. They could not see anything. They heard a loud roar. It was a dragon! The dragon was angry. It did not like children in its mist. It opened its mouth and breathed fire. It destroyed Anna and Ben with its fire. They screamed and cried, but no one heard them. They were gone.
Mommy came to the park to look for Anna and Ben. She saw the mist and the dragon. She was very sad and scared. She wished Anna and Ben had been obedient. She wished they had stayed away from the pond. She wished they had not been destroyed by the dragon.

Once upon a time there was a hairy dragon. Every day, the dragon would go to a meadow and yawn until his sleep came.
One day, a little girl named Lucy saw the dragon in the meadow. She watched him from a distance and saw him yawning. Lucy was fascinated and wanted to see if he would come near her.
So she walked slowly towards the dragon and said "Hi, dragon." The dragon yawned before he replied, "Hello, Lucy." Lucy giggled and asked if she could pet him.
The dragon nodded his big head and said, "Yes, you can pet my hairy scales." So Lucy reached out and put her hand on the dragon's scaly back. The dragon yawned again and said, "That tickles!"
Lucy laughed and said, "Thank you for letting me pet you, dragon! It was so fun!" The dragon smiled, yawned one last time, and flew off.

Once upon a time, there was a fierce dragon. It had big scales and claws, and breathed fire. One day, the dragon came across a fork that belonged to a little boy. 
The dragon was very angry since the little boy had been warned not to leave his toys around the dragon's house. He yelled out at the boy, "Why do you always do this? This time I will have to punish you!" 
The little boy trembled with fear. He knew he couldn't fight against the fierce dragon, so he begged for forgiveness. "Please don't punish me, kind dragon. I'm sorry, I will never do it again." 
But the dragon was still furious. He said sternly, "You must learn that you should never leave your toys around. Therefore, this one time only, I will let you off. But if you do it again, I will punish you!" 
The little boy nodded and ran away as fast as he could. He vowed never to leave his toys near the dragon's house again.

Once upon a time there was a dragon who loved to balance on his tail. Every day, the dragon would try to stand for longer and longer. He loved to show off his talent to the other creatures in the forest. 
One day, the dragon was looking around for something to balance on when he saw a log. He thought it would be fun to see if he could balance on it, so he tried. He wobbled back and forth, but he was able to stay on! All the animals cheered.
The dragon was so proud of himself that he wanted to balance even higher. He thought to himself, "If I can balance on this log, why not a bigger one?" So he found a larger log and tried to balance on it.
He wobbled back and forth, but he couldn't keep his balance. He felt embarrassed and tried to hide his face. The other animals laughed at him and he was really sad.
But the dragon soon realized it was okay. He learnt that if he worked hard, he could do more difficult things. He kept practicing and finally, he could balance on the biggest log in the forest! All the animals cheered and the dragon was so happy.

Once upon a time, in a land far away, there lived a very brave dragon. He was an adorable dragon, and had a weapon to protect himself from the bad people that tried to hurt him. One day, he decided to leave the land and explore the world. He flew around, searching for new things to do and to see. 
He explored in the sea, in the clouds, and in the magical forests. Everywhere he went, people would admire his bravery and cheer him on. Until, one day, he came across a strange land with lots of monsters and evil creatures. He was scared and wanted to return home. 
The brave dragon courageously faced the monsters, and managed to fight his way back to his home. As he arrived home, tired and scared, his family was very happy to see him and hugged him tightly. 
"Welcome home, brave dragon," said his mom. "We are so happy that you have returned safely." 
The dragon smiled back, feeling relieved and grateful to be home. He had learned that it is always important to be brave, no matter how scared you may be.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Sarah. She liked to explore new places by herself. One day Sarah thought she could go for a walk near the river. She asked her mom if she could go for a walk. Her mom said yes and Sarah was very happy.
So Sarah went for the walk wearing her red dress. She loved the calmness of the river. As she walked on the river bank, she saw a black river. She was excited about this new river and decided to go for a closer look.
As she went closer to the riverside, she noticed a loud noise from the depths of the mysterious black river. She was scared, but she decided to take a peek. She saw a giant dragon!
The dragon was furious and saw Sarah. He shouted, "Leave the river! What are you doing here?" Sarah was scared and started to cry. She ran away as fast as she could and went back home.
The dragon was never seen since then, but Sarah definitely learned her lesson. She never ventured so close to the black river again.

Once upon a time, there lived a rock. It was alone in the big field, with no other stones nearby. The rock felt very lonely. 
One bright morning, a strong wind blew across the field, lifting the rock up and carrying it away. Soar the rock went, flying higher and higher in the sky.
The rock kept flying until it spotted a kind dragon. The dragon saw the rock and smiled. The dragon asked the rock if it wanted to fly with them. The rock said yes, and the dragon allowed it to get onto its back.
For hours, the rock and dragon flew together through the sky, visiting different lands and meeting new animals. The dragon showed the rock many wonderful things that they could do together. The rock was so happy to have a new friend.
Eventually, the dragon said it was time to go home. The rock thanked the dragon for allowing it to go on such an adventure, and with that, the dragon flew the rock back home to the lonely field. The rock was so glad it had found a new friend, and the two would keep in touch forever.

Once upon a time there was a brave hero called Tom. Tom wanted to show everyone how brave he was, so he decided to go out on an adventure. Everyone mentioned how brave and daring he was, and so Tom set off.
On his way, Tom soon encountered a restless dragon. Being a brave hero, Tom didn't hesitate and rushed straight up to the dragon. The dragon was so surprised and frightened that it backed off and ran away as fast as it could.
Tom was so proud of himself but, unfortunately, he didn't know when to stop. He was so restless that he kept challenging more and more dangers. Finally he had to face a huge beast that was much more powerful than the dragon.
Tom fought bravely but he was no match for the beast. It easily overpowered him and Tom was never seen again.
The moral of the story is that being brave and restless can be dangerous. A hero should know when to draw the line and not push their luck too much.

Once upon a time, there lived a brave boy named Jack. He had a big adventure ahead of him; he wanted to find a dragon. Every day he would gather as many clues as possible so he could find his dragon.
He asked around and asked his parents, but nobody really knew where to find one. Jack was determined though! He asked the birds, he asked the trees, he asked the clouds - nobody seemed to know.
Jack kept gathering more clues until he stumbled across a small cave. He was very excited - the cave looked like it was just the right size for a dragon. Jack went inside, hoping to find his dragon.
He searched and searched, until he heard a loud rumble. He followed the sound, and there was the dragon! The dragon was so happy to see Jack, and they quickly became friends.
With the help of his new dragon friend, Jack was able to complete his adventure and turn it into a successful one. The dragon had helped Jack find what he was searching for, and they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big, powerful dragon. He lived in a cave and loved to breathe fire. One day, he accidentally burned down his stove and couldn't cook his food. He was very sad.
The dragon decided to ask his friends, the birds, for help. The birds told him to bury his stove in the ground and it would turn into a magical oven. The dragon did what the birds said and buried his stove.
But then, a mean fox came and tried to steal the dragon's magical oven. The dragon had to fight the fox to protect his oven. In the end, the dragon won and the fox ran away.
Now, the dragon had a new and powerful oven to cook his food. He was very happy and thanked the birds for their help. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big dragon named Timmy. Timmy loved to fly around and play with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends were flying east when they saw a big castle. 
Timmy said, "Wow, that castle looks amazing! Let's go check it out!" 
As they got closer, they saw that the castle was being destroyed by a big storm. Timmy's friend, Sally, said, "Oh no, we have to help them!" 
So, Timmy and his friends used their dragon fire to help put out the fire and save the castle. The people in the castle were very happy and thanked Timmy and his friends for their help. 
From that day on, Timmy and his friends were known as the amazing dragons who saved the castle from being destroyed.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lucy was walking through the park with her mom. As they rounded a corner, Lucy suddenly saw a big yellow surprise! It was a huge yellow balloon, tied to a bench. Lucy was so excited and ran up to the balloon, but when she got closer she realized that it wasn't a real balloon. It was a scary yellow monster!
Lucy stepped back, feeling very fearful and didn't know what to do. But then, she saw something amazing. Two little wings were peeking out from behind the monster's back! Lucy cautiously walked closer, and discovered that the yellow balloon was actually a friendly yellow dragon!
The dragon was so happy to see Lucy that it smiled and flew into the air, leaving behind a rainbow of balloons for Lucy to play with. Lucy smiled in delight, feeling very surprised and happy that the dragon was her new friend. They ran and played together until it was time to head home, and the next time they met the dragon was full of yellow surprises!

Once upon a time, there was a dragon in a light forest. He loved to laugh and make others laugh too. Every day, the dragon would find a new way to play. One day, he made funny faces in a bush. It made a rabbit laugh. The rabbit was so tickled it jumped up and down.
Then, the dragon heard a little voice coming from the trees. He looked up, and saw a little girl with long golden hair. She said she was three years old. The dragon invited the girl to play with him.
The little girl and the dragon ran through the light forest laughing. They played all day until the sun started to go down. When it was time to go, the little girl waved goodbye to the dragon. She said she had a lot of fun and was sad to go.
The dragon was so happy that he made a wish. He wished that the little girl could come back and play with him every day. He made a promise that he always would be there waiting for her.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight named Tim. Tim had a shiny shield that he loved very much. He would always carry it with him wherever he went.
One day, Tim went on a big adventure to save a princess from an evil dragon. The dragon was very scary and had big teeth and sharp claws. Tim knew he needed to be very brave to defeat the dragon.
As Tim got closer to the dragon's lair, he saw the princess tied up and scared. Tim knew he had to act fast. He took out his shield and used it to protect himself from the dragon's fire breath. Then, he charged at the dragon and gave it an amazing kiss with his sword. The dragon fell to the ground and Tim saved the princess.
Everyone cheered for Tim and his amazing bravery. Tim knew that his shield had helped him in his adventure and he would always keep it close by.

Once upon a time there was a little bird. He loved to soar in the sky and marveled at the world below. One day, he spied a mysterious volcano in the distance. He flapped his wings and flew closer to take a look. 
He was so excited to get a closer view of the volcano, but he couldn't get too close. He called out to the volcano, "Hello! What are you?"
The volcano rumbled in response and the little bird was scared. Soon, the top of the volcano opened and a huge orange dragon soared out, scattering fire and heat. The dragon roared, "I am a dragon! I live here in this mysterious volcano!"
The little bird was amazed. He thanked the dragon and flew away. From that day on, whenever the little bird flew in the sky, he would always look for the mysterious volcano and the pretty dragon living inside.

Once upon a time there was a special castle, made for a princess. The princess loved throwing outdoor parties, so the castle had a big park with lots of toys and games.
One day the princess had a very special picnic in the park. She brought a unique missile to play with. It was very special, with a big green sack filled with candy and toys.
Suddenly a dragon appeared in the sky! The dragon said in a loud voice, 'Give me the missile!'.
The princess bravely stood up and said, 'No, it is mine'. The dragon was mad and flew away.
The princess was very brave. Everyone cheered for her. She hugged the missile tightly and said, 'My unique missile is safe!'

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tommy. He was three years old and he liked to have lots of fun. One day, Tommy was playing in his backyard. He was imagining flying up in the sky to a magical land. 
Suddenly, Tommy saw a flag fluttering in the wind. He said to himself, "What a nice flag! Where did it come from?" He hopped up and ran to get a closer look. 
He saw a dragon with colorful wings carrying the flag. He was amazed. The dragon looked at him and spoke, "Hello little one. I'm looking for someone special. Do you know anyone who is nice and likes to have fun?"
Tommy smiled and said, "Yes, I am nice and I love to have fun!" The dragon smiled back and said, "Then you should take this flag. It is a magical flag and it will help you with your adventures."
With a smile on his face, Tommy thanked the dragon for the flag and promised to keep it safe. He imagined all the adventures he could have and the places he could explore. 
The dragon gave Tommy a big hug and flew away. Tommy waved goodbye, holding his magical flag tightly and a big smiled on his face.

Tommy was a brave knight who wanted to protect his kingdom. He had a shield which his father had given him. But it was broken.
One day, Tommy saw a dragon flying over his house! The dragon was fierce and angry. Tommy needed to save everyone.
Tommy grabbed the broken shield and ran outside. He shouted to the dragon, "Go away! or I'll put my shield up!"
The dragon laughed and said, "Your shield is broken, I won't be scared!"
But Tommy didn't give up. He put the shield up in front of him and held it strongly. The dragon was so surprised that it quickly flew away!
Everyone applauded Tommy for his bravery. He had saved the kingdom with his broken shield.

Once upon a time, there was a big dragon. The dragon had wide wings and could fly high up in the sky. One day, the dragon was flying and suddenly he lost his balance and fell down. The dragon fell into a big lake and got all wet. He was scared but luckily he could swim. After a while, the dragon got out of the lake and dried himself in the sun. From that day on, the dragon was more careful when he flew so he wouldn't fall again.

Once upon a time, in a forest far away, there lived a fairy named Prommie. She was very independent and loved spending her days exploring the enchanted woods.
On one of her walks she stumbled and fell on a large rock causing her to cry. Suddenly a large blue dragon flew overhead and landed in front of her.
"Hello Prommie," said the dragon. "What is wrong?"
Prommie sobbed. "I stumbled and hurt my knee," she said.
The dragon smiled kindly. "Don't worry," he said. "I have something that will make it better."
The dragon picked up a twinkling red crystal and gave it to Prommie. 
"Whenever you feel hurt," said the dragon, "just hold this crystal and it will make you feel better."
Prommie thanked the dragon and smiled. She clutched the crystal tight and felt better.
With a deep breath Prommie vowed to never stop exploring, no matter how much she stumbled.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play dress-up. One day, Lily put on a princess costume, but she didn't like it. "This costume is boring," she said to her mom.
Suddenly, Lily heard a loud noise outside. She looked out the window and saw a big, scary dragon! "Oh no!" cried Lily. "We have to escape!"
Lily and her mom ran out of the house and into the street. They saw all their neighbors running too. "What's going on?" asked Lily.
"There's a dragon attacking the town!" said a neighbor. "We have to hide!"
Lily thought quickly. She remembered her princess costume and put it back on. "I know how to save us!" she said. She ran up to the dragon and said, "Mr. Dragon, I am Princess Lily. Please don't hurt us!"
The dragon was so surprised that he stopped attacking. "Oh, Princess Lily," he said. "I'm sorry for scaring you. I just wanted to play." Lily and the dragon became friends and everyone in the town was safe.

Once there was a fierce dragon. He lived in the closet, curled up into a tight ball. 
Every day, the dragon slowly rose above the floor of the closet. He stretched, and he yawned. He slowly made his way out of the closet. 
One day, the dragon heard a loud noise coming from outside of the closet. He was curious, and he decided to leave the closet. He slowly stepped out, and saw a fearsome knight! The knight was preparing to battle a fierce monster.
The dragon could sense a great danger. He spread out his wings, and bravely stepped forward. He charged towards the knight and monster, roaring fiercely. He was determined to protect them from danger. 
The dragon's courage took the knight and monster by surprise. Together, they were able to defeat the fierce monster. The knight thanked the dragon for his bravery, and the dragon returned proudly to the closet and curled up for a long sleep.

He wiggled his toes. He knew that his big day was here. He was going to be a super hero. He'd been practicing, determined to help his friends in need. He'd even made his own super hero gear. He grabbed his cape and put it on. Everyone cheered for him. He felt so brave and fierce.
He flew around helping all the animals he came across. If a bird had a broken wing, he was there to help. He'd use his gear to repair it. If a bee got stuck in a bush he'd use a stick to help it get free. He put smiles on all their faces.
Then he heard a loud roar. A fierce dragon was coming! Everyone was scared but not him. He flew up and grabbed his gear. He was ready to fight! But the dragon was too strong. He was about to give up, when a voice said "I can help". He looked around and saw his friends, each armed with their own gear.
Together they fought the fierce dragon. Finally, they defeated it and everyone cheered. He was a hero again! He had learned that with a lot of determination and help, even a 3 year old could be a super hero!

Once upon a time there was a little dragon. He was very fast and could fly through the sky. One day he was flying through space and the wind blew hard against him. His wings flapped hard and fast and soon he was high in the sky.
The dragon felt brave and said "I am the king of the sky". He opened his mouth wide and roared loudly. It was so loud it shook the sky and stars. He roared and roared again. Soon everyone could hear him roaring.
The dragon flew faster and higher, with each roar growing louder. He was so fast he almost disappeared and then he flew back down to the earth.
The dragon was so proud he had been able to show his strength and roar so loudly in space. He had conquered the sky and that made him very happy. He started to roar again and his roar echoed in the sky long after he'd gone!

Once upon a time there was a boy called Tom. He loved to play with his toys and go for adventures.
One day, Tom found a mysterious box in a thick forest. He opened it and something magical happened - a white dragon flew out!
"Wow," Tom exclaimed. The dragon flew high up in the sky and it was beautiful.
Tom was so excited, he wanted to share this with his friends. So he asked the dragon to bring his friends to the forest.
The dragon flew in big circles around Tom's house. Soon, Tom's friends and family were all in the forest, gazing up at the magical dragon. Tom was so happy, and everyone cheered. 
The dragon flew away and left the family with lots of happy memories. Tom was so proud of his magical friend!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Grace. Grace loved dragons more than anything else. She used to like to store all her dragon toys in her bedroom.
One night, Grace heard a strange noise coming from her bedroom. She went to investigate and found an original dragon! Grace was so excited and wondered how it got into her bedroom.
The dragon said, "Hello Grace, I'm here to make your dreams come true!" Grace was surprised to hear the dragon talking and asked, "What do you mean?". 
The dragon smiled and said, "One day, I will take you to a magical castle in the sky, where your wildest dreams will be fulfilled!"
Grace was excited and asked when she could go. The dragon replied, "Soon! When the time is right, I will store you away and take you to the magical castle!" 
Grace smiled and thanked the dragon for the promise. She looked forward to visiting the castle and all the magical adventures she would experience there.

Once upon a time, there was a brave boy named David. He had a special sword and he was very proud of it. Every day he would take it out with him and proudly walk around, whistling happily.
But one day, David met a restless dragon. The dragon wanted to fight and he was fiercely roaring and snarling. David's brave heart started to beat fast but he bravely reached out and grabbed his sword.
He began to whistle courageously as he walked towards the dragon and pointed the sword towards it. The dragon was surprised to see the brave boy and stepped back in fear.
David let out a loud whistle and the dragon flew away, never to be seen again. David was thrilled with his bravery and proudly wore his sword wherever he went after that. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Timmy and Kate. They were playing one day and decided to wander in the woods. As they were walking, they stumbled upon a large chest. Kate said, "Ooh, what is this?". Timmy said, "Let's open it!" So they opened the chest, but it was empty.
Kate became sad and said, "What a shame, I was hoping to find something special." Timmy replied, "Oh well, let's keep exploring then." But as they continued to wander, they heard a wicked laughter. A giant dragon appeared and said, "You two shall not escape!". 
Timmy and Kate screamed in fear and tried to run away. However, the dragon was too fast and caught them both in its claws. The dragon took them away and they were never seen again.

Robbie wanted to visit the dragon. Every day he went outside and looked for it, but he never saw it. He was so frustrated! One day his dad said he was going to take Robbie for a visit. They drove for a long time and when they stopped Robbie saw a big dragon! It was so big and shiny! Robbie was so excited. He ran up to the dragon and said hello. The dragon smiled back at him and thankfully the dragon was friendly! Robbie and his dad spent the whole day visiting the dragon. They laughed and had lots of fun. Robbie was sad when it was time to go home. He had such a great time visiting the dragon!

Once upon a time, there lived a weird dragon. He lived on top of a mountain, far away from any other creature. Everyday, the dragon would weigh himself to make sure he was the same size.
One day, the dragon noticed his weight was different. He couldn't understand why. He thought and thought until he figured it out. He had a new friend!
The dragon looked around and saw a tiny little mouse. He had never seen it before! The dragon called out to the mouse, calling it his friend. The mouse replied and they were best buddies from then on.
Everyday, the dragon would weigh himself and the mouse as well. He wanted to make sure they both stayed the same size. The dragon and the mouse were happy together, living at the top of the mountain and being weird together.

One day, a young boy was walking through the woods. He stopped to look at some attractive flowers. Suddenly, he heard a voice.
"Come join me, and settle down in life," it said.
The boy looked all around, but he couldn't find anybody.
"Where are you?" he asked.
"Down here!" the voice replied.
The boy finally figured out where the voice was coming from. At the bottom of a deep pit was a dragon.
"Please let me go!" the boy begged.
But the dragon refused.
"I want you to settle down in life and stay here with me," the dragon said.
The boy knew he wouldn't be able to get away and he had no choice but to settle down in the life the dragon wanted him to live. He was never seen again.

Once upon a time there was a little bird named Sam. Sam loved to fly high among the trees, but one day he started to worry about his feathers. They were getting missing and feeling rough.
Sam was a brave bird and he asked his best friend, a dragonfly, for help.
"Hey, Dragonfly," Sam said. "Do you know how to help me make my feathers soft?"
Dragonfly smiled, "Of course! All you need is a spicy oil and you can rub it into your feathers. Then you won't have to worry anymore!"
Sam was so happy. With a quick flap of his wings, he flew off to find the spicy oil. He rubbed it into every single feather and they felt much softer.
Now Sam can happily fly around the trees without worry.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, especially his toy dragon. The dragon was big and gray, and Timmy loved to pretend he was flying on its back.
One day, Timmy and his mom went to the park. Timmy brought his toy dragon with him, but he accidentally threw it too far and it landed in a bush. Timmy was sad because he thought he lost his dragon forever.
But then, Timmy's mom saw something moving in the bush. She walked over and found Timmy's toy dragon! Timmy was so happy and he hugged his mom tightly. From that day on, Timmy made sure to be careful when he threw his toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to look at pictures in his books. One day, Timmy's mom took him to the museum. Timmy was so eager to see all the pictures!
As they walked through the museum, Timmy saw many beautiful images. He pointed at each one and said, "Look, Mommy! Look at this one!" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, that's a very pretty picture."
Suddenly, Timmy saw a painting of a big, scary dragon. He pointed at it and said, "Mommy, what's that?" His mom replied, "That's a dragon, Timmy. But don't worry, it's just a picture. Dragons aren't real." Timmy felt relieved and continued to point at more pictures as they walked through the museum.

Once upon a time there was a small skeleton. He was very afraid and didn't know what to do. He was very lonely.
One day, the skeleton heard a voice calling to him. "Come out, little skeleton. I want to be your friend".
The skeleton was very scared, but eventually he stepped out of his hiding place. He was amazed to see a friendly dragon. The dragon smiled at the skeleton and said, "I know you are scared, but I want to help you. Will you accept me as your friend?"
The skeleton thought about it and then slowly nodded his head. The dragon smiled and said, "That's great! Now you can be part of my family."
The small skeleton was very happy and accepted the dragon's offer. They became the best of friends and had lots of fun together.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight. He had a big shield that was shiny and strong. The shield could protect him from all the bad things. The knight was very powerful and could fight all the scary monsters. 
One day, the knight met a dragon. The dragon was very big and had fire in its mouth. The knight tried to fight the dragon, but he couldn't win. The dragon was too powerful. 
The knight didn't know what to do, so he shrugged his shoulders. Suddenly, he had an idea! He took his shield and held it up high. The dragon breathed fire at the shield, but it didn't hurt the knight. The shield was so powerful that it protected him from the dragon's fire. 
The knight was very happy and defeated the dragon. From then on, he knew that his shield was his best friend and always protected him. The end.

In the morning, the sun shone brightly. The bird flew up and perched on the chimney. Down below, Joe and his mommy headed to the market. Joe skipped happily, kicking stones along the way. 
When they arrived, Joe saw many things to explore. He found some sour lemons and couldn't resist a taste. Joe made a funny face and said, "Yuck". 
Eventually, they reached the end of the market. Joe heard something buzzing and he looked up. There, in the sky, he saw the most beautiful thing- a big, shiny dragonfly. Joe was amazed and pointed in awe. 
Mommy looked up, smiled and said, "Shine on, little one." Joe knew his mommy was right. He waved goodbye at the dragonfly, and it flew off and disappeared into the sky. 
Joe and his mommy knew that was just the beginning of a wonderful adventure. From then on, Joe always looked up to find the dragonfly, wherever he went, and it would always shine down on him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to design things. One day, he wanted to design a big dragon. He thought it would be fun to have a dragon friend.
But Tim got frustrated. Making a dragon was hard. He tried and tried, but it did not look like a dragon at all. He was sad and wanted to give up. Then, his mom said, "Don't worry, keep trying and you will make a great dragon."
The next day, Tim tried again. He thought about what his mom said. He worked very hard. And then, something amazing happened. The dragon he designed looked just like a real dragon! Tim was so happy. He knew that if he kept trying, he could do anything.

Once upon a time, there was a brave knight with a shiny sword. He wanted to protect his castle from evil monsters.
The knight searched everywhere, but the monsters were nowhere to be found. He became very frustrated.
Suddenly, a big dragon swooped down from the sky. The knight was scared, but he stayed brave and held his sword up high. The dragon roared and blew hot air from its mouth.
The knight felt brave and shouted a loud scream. The dragon was so scared it flew away. Everyone in the castle was very happy and cheered for the brave knight.

Little Jack was feeling nosy one day. He looked around his house to find something to do and noticed a bright red leaf lying on the floor. Jack was excited and he picked it up, eager to show it to his mum. He tried to take the leaf to his mum, but then he heard a voice.
It was a big, scary dragon. He was trembling with fear. The dragon was looking straight at Jack. Jack quickly jumped behind his mum.
The dragon said "I am here for that leaf". Jack was very scared and he silently handed the leaf over to the dragon. The dragon thanked Jack and flew away.
Jack was still trembling when his mum asked him what had happened. After telling her the story, Jack ran off and hugged his teddy. He was very happy that he had been brave and returned the leaf safely to its rightful owner.

Once upon a time, there lived a fierce dragon in a cave on the edge of the forest. The dragon had orange scales and two long horns on its head.
One day, the dragon heard a curious whisper from the forest. It was soft but as clear as a bell. The dragon decided to peek inside and see who it came from.
Gently, the dragon sneaked through a loop of trees and bushes. As it came closer to the voice, the dragon's curiosity grew.
When the dragon found the source, it discovered a tiny fairy with a wand. The fairy looked surprised, but spoke in a gentle voice.
The fairy said, "Oh Dragon! What brings you here today?"
The dragon smiled and whispered back, "I heard your sweet whisper and wanted to meet you!" 
The fairy chuckled and thanked the dragon for its courage.
The dragon and fairy then became great friends, and their friendship remained strong and fierce.

Once upon a time there was a princess who loved to comb her hair. Every morning she used her big pink comb and carefully made sure her hair was soft and pretty.
But one day, she got into a fight with a dragon! He was green and fiery and he scared the princess very much. She wanted to surrender and make the dragon go away.
The dragon roared, "If you want me to leave, then give me your comb!"
The princess thought for a moment and bravely replied, "No! I don't want to give you my comb, I need it for my pretty hair."
The dragon was surprised. He said, "Very well, if you won't surrender the comb, then I'll go."
The princess was relieved and she hugged her comb close to her heart. From that day on, she kept her comb safe and used it every morning so her hair stayed soft and pretty.

Once upon a time, there was a small soldier who was very eager to go on an adventure. He wanted to zoom around and see the world. So, he packed his bag and set off.
As he walked, he saw a big, scary dragon. The soldier was very brave and said, "Hello, Mr. Dragon. Do you want to be friends?"
The dragon replied, "No, I want to eat you!" And with that, he swallowed the soldier whole.
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Jim. Jim was a strong and brave dog who lived in the countryside. One day, Jim decided to go on an adventure and visit a magical place. 
So, early one morning, he set out. Before long, Jim had reached a big, old castle. Jim was curious to explore the castle and soon, he heard a voice coming from inside. 
The voice said: "Welcome, Jim! Come on in and visit." 
Jim was a little afraid, so he barked in response. Then, he heard a laugh. 
The voice said: "Don't be scared. I'm only the fierce dragon who lives here. You can be my guest!" Jim was relieved, so he entered the castle.
Once inside, the dragon told Jim about all the exciting things he would get to see and do. He said: "There are words like you've never heard before. You'll have to be brave". 
Jim smiled and agreed to the dragon's offer. The dragon smiled back and said: "Let's have an adventure!". 
So, with that, Jim and the dragon, set off on a journey full of exploration and fun. All the while, Jim listened carefully to the dragon's words.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to observe the birds and the flowers and the clouds. They saw many shapes in the clouds. They saw a bunny, a car, a star and a dragon.
"Look, Lily, a dragon!" Tom said, pointing at the sky. "It is big and green and has wings and fire."
"Wow, a dragon!" Lily said, looking up. "It is cute and friendly and wants to play with us."
They waved at the dragon and smiled. They hoped the dragon would come down and say hello. They did not know that the dragon was hungry and angry and did not like children.
The dragon saw Tom and Lily and licked its lips. It flew down fast and loud and opened its mouth. It breathed fire and smoke and roared.
"Help, help!" Tom and Lily cried, running away. "The dragon is not cute and friendly, it is mean and scary and wants to eat us."
But it was too late. The dragon caught them and swallowed them whole. It was happy and full and flew away. It did not care about the birds and the flowers and the clouds. It only cared about itself.

Once upon a time, there was a charming, little girl named Lily. Lily was so sweet and liked to play with her favorite toy - a big, colorful dictionary. Every day, she would whisper the names of the different animals and plants in the dictionary. 
One afternoon, while she was having fun, an evil dragon suddenly showed up! The dragon began to grunt and growl at poor Lily. She was so scared that she began to cry, and the dragon came closer and closer. In a loud voice, the dragon said, "Give me your dictionary, or else!"
Lily was so scared that she was trembling, but she was brave and stood her ground. "No!" she whispered. "This is my favorite toy! Please, go away!"
But the dragon would not listen, and he snarled angrily at poor Lily. He opened his mighty jaws and breathed fire, burning the dictionary to a crisp.
Lily cryed and cryed until she had no more tears. Poor Lily never played with her dictionary ever again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play pretend with his toys. One day, he pretended to be a brave knight who had to fight a scary dragon. The dragon was big and green, with sharp teeth and a long tail. 
Timmy didn't have a real sword, so he used a cheap plastic one from his toy box. He swung it at the dragon and yelled, "Take that, dragon!" The dragon roared and breathed fire, but Timmy was brave and didn't give up. 
In the end, Timmy defeated the dragon and saved the princess. He was very proud of himself and couldn't wait to pretend to be a different hero next time. The end.

Once there was a strong figure who was a knight. He was brave and never gave up. The knight went on a journey to save the kingdom from danger. Everywhere the knight went, he was careful and proud.
But, there was a dragon blocking the knight's path. The dragon ignored the knight and did not let him pass. The knight was scared but knew he had to be strong. He decided to not give up, and gathered his courage.
The knight fought bravely with his sword and shield. The dragon kept ignoring him, until the knight finally defeated the dragon. The knight had saved the kingdom and celebrated with a grand party. Everyone was proud of the knight and thankful for his courage.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Dina. Dina liked to measure things. One day, she saw a stick in the grass. Dina thought it would be fun to measure things with the stick.
So Dina grabbed the stick and she went outside. It was very cold outside. She wanted to measure how wide the gate was. She began to measure, but with each step she took, the stick seemed to get longer!
"What's happening?" she said out loud.
Suddenly, a dragon appeared! "I can help you," said the dragon. "When it is cold, sticks can stretch!"
Dina thanked the dragon, and they both laughed. She used the stick to measure how wide the gate was. Then she went inside to get warm again.

Once there was a dragon who lived in the park. He was an honest dragon, who talked to everyone who visited. One day, two boys came to the park and they weren't honest. They plotted to trap the dragon in the park forever. 
The boys thought of a clever plan: they would build a cage around the dragon so he wouldn't be able to leave. The dragon saw what was happening but he couldn't do anything to stop them. He tried to talk to them but they refused to listen.
The dragon was very sad. He was stuck in the park and he couldn't get out. He cried and shouted for help but nobody heard him. He was stuck in the park forever. 
The end.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. They like to swing on the swings. They like to see the sky and the clouds.
One day, they see a big cloud that looks like a dragon. Anna says, "Look, Ben, a dragon cloud!" Ben says, "Wow, it is a dragon cloud! It is so big and scary!" They swing higher and higher, pretending to fly with the dragon cloud.
But then, the wind blows the cloud away. The cloud becomes smaller and smaller. It moves to a distant place. Anna and Ben are sad. They say, "Bye, dragon cloud! Come back soon!"
They swing lower and lower, until they stop. They get off the swings. They hold hands and walk to the slide. They say, "Maybe we will see another cloud that looks like something fun. What do you think, Anna?" "I think so, Ben. Maybe we will see a cloud that looks like a flower, or a star, or a bird. Let's go and see!" They smile and run to the slide. They are happy again.

Once upon a time there was a mighty dragon. Flying across the sky, the dragon ruled over the land with might and power.
One day, the dragon saw a strange gift near a river. The gift was wrapped in a giant bow and flew through the air.
The dragon swooped down and picked up the mysterious present. When the dragon unwrapped it, he recognized that it was an enchanted sword.
The dragon was very happy! He thanked the gift giver then flew around the world with his new powerful weapon.
The dragon felt mighty with his new sword. From then on, he used it to keep peace and order across the land.

Once upon a time there lived a purple dragon. The dragon liked to fly around the sky and had a huge head. But sometimes it felt like people were trying to make it feel bad.
One day the dragon was feeling particularly sad. As it flew over the village, it heard a child shouting out at it. "Go away dragon!"
The dragon felt very hurt and it wanted to resist, but it didn't know how. It flew away to hide on top of a mountain.
The dragon wept with sadness until it felt a gentle hand on its shoulder. It looked around and saw a fairy holding a magical wand. "Do not resist your sadness," the fairy said.
The dragon looked into the fairy's eyes and it felt calm. It breathed in deeply and let its sadness go. Then the fairy touched the wand to the dragon's head and it felt an immense peace.
From then on, the dragon always remembered that it was ok to resist, but it must also stay strong enough to move forward.

Ben was a brave knight. He had a sword and a shield. He liked to play with his friends and fight dragons. But one day, he had to go to his grandma's house. He did not want to go. He wanted to stay and play.
He packed his sword and his shield in his bag. He said goodbye to his friends. He got in the car with his mom and dad. He felt gloomy. He missed his friends and his dragons.
At his grandma's house, he did not have much fun. His grandma was nice, but she did not have any toys. She only had books and puzzles. Ben did not like books and puzzles. He liked swords and shields.
He tried to play with his sword and his shield in the yard. But there were no dragons. There were only birds and flowers. Ben did not like birds and flowers. He liked dragons.
He wished he could go back to his friends. He wished he could fight dragons. He wished he could be a brave knight again. He missed his sword and his shield. He missed his fun. He missed his home.

Once upon a time there was a rich man who lived in a big house. He had a special measuring tool that he used to measure barrels. Every day he would go out into the woods and measure barrels full of special stones. 
One day he found a very big barrel that was heavier than the others. As he began to measure it, he noticed something was moving inside the barrel. He reached in and found a tiny baby dragon! He was so surprised and excited! 
He quickly ran back to his house and showed his friends the dragon. All of the people were amazed because it was so cute. The rich man then realized that the dragon was the secret to his wealth. He decided to keep the dragon and measure many more barrels of special stones to become even richer.
The man and his dragon lived happily ever after, and he was always measuring barrels full of special stones for the dragon.
